items.question: How are the worship portion and circumference to be divided in the arrangement of the thousand liṅgas?
premises: The worship portion is divided into four parts.
The circumference is divided into twenty-seven parts.
These two divisions apply as contrasting measures in the arrangement.
items.inference: The arrangement of the thousand liṅgas requires a fourfold division in the worship portion and a twenty-sevenfold division in the circumference.
uncertainties: The precise spatial referent of arcā-aṃśe in this ritual layout is not fully explicit from the verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the worship portion, divide it into four parts, but in the circumference, divide it into twenty-seven parts.
